title: Seven Delivery Modes, Creator/GM Control & World/Roster Binding

selection_basis.strict_order: GPR-01 → GPR-03 → GPR-05 → GPR-06 → GPR-07 → GPR-08 → GPR-09 → GPR-10 → GPR-12 → GPR-16
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS is terminal completed_verified; OARC-06 remains independently selected_not_started.

objective: Implement direct, cozy/low-pressure, GM-led, world-map/TTRPG bridge, embedded-minigame, user-authored loop-mini and roster-injection delivery adapters over one state/outcome model, plus GPR-specific Creator/GM test/control surfaces, World/Map/Adventure binding and Character roster injection using Packet-07 shared execution-inspection semantics.
acceptance: All seven delivery modes project the same underlying GPR state/outcome model rather than separate mechanics engines.
Loop test/preview and Creator/GM controls reuse Packet-07 shared preview/dry-run/commit/explanation/intervention/recovery semantics instead of creating a generic studio framework.
World/Map/Adventure bindings preserve external canonical identity and mutation authority.
Character roster injection consumes explicit Character owner references and cannot replace Character truth.
Mode support is explicit and unsupported delivery modes fail closed while preserving GPR-08 authored configuration.
Visibility/permission filtering is applied before participant, target, diagnostic, preview/export or GM-control projections.
boundaries: GPR-01 through GPR-08 remain predecessors and are not duplicated.
GPR-09 owns GPR-specific delivery/control adapters only; generic creator/debug/studio authority remains external.
World/Map/Adventure and Character owners retain canonical identity and mutation truth.
Packet-07 shared execution-inspection semantics are reused rather than reimplemented.
GPR-10+ presentation, continuity and final proof remain unauthorized.
next_action: On a GPR-specific owner Continue, fresh-read GPR-09, published GPR predecessor evidence, Packet-07 shared execution-inspection semantics, the GPR family design closure and ops3-lane-state/gpr, then execute the complete bounded seven-mode/Creator-GM/world-roster tranche.
